text:
zoe: FYI rolling svc-auth v2.4.1 into the 15:00 PT change window. No DB migrations. Canary at 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m intervals. Pin for rollback: v2.4.0 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy started by zoe. Canary slice: 10% -> monitoring 5m. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/svc-auth/4123456789 :rocket:

simon: quick Q — any config toggles that need to be flipped post-canary?

zoe: no toggles. feature flag remains off. If we see token errors, flip `AUTH_LEGACY_FALLBACK=true` and pin service to v2.4.0.

jax: I'll take the metrics watch. If latency p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive mins, I'll trigger the unwind. :eyes:

maria: Adding runbook pointer and exact unwind steps: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/ops/unwind-auth
- Step 1: `kubectl -n auth rollout undo deployment svc-auth --to-revision=stable-v2.4.0`
- Step 2: `redis-cli --eval scripts/clear_kv_cache.lua` (if cache pressure observed)
- Step 3: pin routing rule: `routectl pin svc-auth v2.4.0`
- Step 4: notify #eng-oncall and exec postmortem checklist

simon: thanks. Can we add a short preflight check command I can run from my laptop?

maria: Yep -- run `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token" https://staging-auth.redwood/api/health | jq .` should return `{"db":"ok", "cache":"ok"}`. If cache shows degraded, follow Step 2 above.

oncall-bot: Reminder: change window ends 16:00 PT. Escalation chain: zoe -> simon -> eng-oncall.

jax: Canary at 10% stable. Watching error-rate and retry budget. Holding the manual abort hook if error-rate > 2% for 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 50% (15:20 PT). No errors above threshold.

zoe: If we need a fast unwind, prefer `routectl pin` first (instant), then rollout undo as a secondary. Route pin = safer for stateful sessions.

simon: noted. I'll have the pin command ready in the terminal.

maria: One more note in runbook: run `psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM sessions WHERE created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'"` before pin to confirm session churn low.

jax: 100% rollout complete at 15:35 PT. No sign of token errors, p95 steady. Closing watch but staying on-call for 30m. :thumbsup:

zoe: Great work team — leaving post-deploy checklist in #eng-releases for notes and release notes draft. If any rollback needed, follow runbook steps and ping me.
